description: This bar chart illustrates the scores achieved by three different models – SRPO-7B, GRPO-7B, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B – across four benchmarks: MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro, and Physics. The horizontal axis represents the benchmark name, listed in the order MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro, and Physics, while the vertical axis represents the score, labeled “Score”, with a linear scale ranging from 35 to 80, marked with tick labels at intervals of 5.  The chart displays grouped bars for each benchmark, with each group containing one bar for each model. The SRPO-7B model is consistently represented by a dark blue bar, GRPO-7B by a medium blue bar, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B by a light blue bar. For MathVista the scores are approximately 75.8 for SRPO-7B, 72.3 for GRPO-7B, and 68.2 for Qwen-2.5-VL-7B.  The shortest bars are for Qwen-2.5-VL-7B on the Physics benchmark with a score of 45.4, and the tallest bars are for SRPO-7B on the MathVista benchmark with a score of 75.8. The bars are grouped by benchmark and arranged in order from left to right, representing the four benchmarks listed on the horizontal axis. No bars are visually emphasized or annotated.
